title: Junior Graphic Designer
company: Marcos Quay Sporting excellence Pvt. Ltd.
description:
**Experience:** 0–2 years  
**Employment Type:** Full\-time  
**Location:** \[Location / Hybrid / Remote]  
**Department:** Creative / Design  
**Reports To:** Senior Graphic Designer / Creative Lead

About the Role

We are looking for a creative and detail\-oriented **Junior Graphic Designer** to join our design team. The ideal candidate should have a strong understanding of visual communication, typography, layouts, color theory, and brand aesthetics, along with an interest in creating engaging content for social media and digital platforms.

This role is suitable for **freshers as well as candidates with up to 2 years of professional experience**. We value strong design fundamentals, creativity, attention to detail, willingness to learn, and the ability to translate ideas into visually compelling designs.

The role will involve creating **social media creatives, digital marketing assets, campaign visuals, brand collateral, presentations, and other graphic design requirements**.

We believe in design driven by creativity and craft. **Strong manual design skills are important, and AI\-generated artwork should not be relied upon as a substitute for core graphic design ability.**

Key ResponsibilitiesGraphic Design

* Create visually appealing and on\-brand designs for digital and offline communication.
* Develop social media creatives for platforms such as Instagram, Facebook, LinkedIn, X, and other relevant channels.
* Design static posts, carousels, stories, reels covers, thumbnails, banners, ads, and other digital assets.
* Assist in developing creative concepts and visual directions for campaigns.
* Work with existing brand guidelines to maintain consistency across all communication.
* Create marketing collateral such as brochures, flyers, posters, presentations, emailers, digital banners, and promotional material.
* Adapt existing designs into different sizes and formats while maintaining visual consistency.
* Work with typography, imagery, illustrations, icons, shapes, colors, and layouts effectively.
* Prepare artwork according to platform, digital, and print specifications.
* Make design revisions based on feedback from the creative, marketing, or content teams.
* Organize design files and maintain clean, editable, and properly structured source files.

Social Media Creatives

* Create engaging and visually consistent content for social media campaigns.
* Translate content, briefs, concepts, and marketing messages into effective visual communication.
* Design creative assets based on social media trends while ensuring they remain aligned with the brand identity.
* Understand basic differences in creative requirements across platforms.
* Create multiple creative variations for campaigns, advertisements, announcements, promotions, and events.
* Collaborate with content writers and social media managers to develop cohesive visual \+ copy combinations.
* Stay updated with evolving design trends, social media formats, visual styles, and digital content trends.

Collaboration \& Execution

* Understand creative briefs and ask relevant questions when requirements are unclear.
* Work closely with marketing, social media, content, and other internal teams.
* Manage multiple design requests and meet agreed timelines.
* Be receptive to feedback and implement revisions efficiently.
* Take ownership of assigned design tasks from brief to final delivery.
* Participate in brainstorming and contribute creative ideas to campaigns and projects.
* Maintain a well\-organized library of design assets, templates, fonts, images, and source files.

Required SkillsDesign Fundamentals

A good understanding of the following is expected:

* Composition and layout
* Typography
* Color theory
* Visual hierarchy
* Spacing and alignment
* Image selection and treatment
* Branding and visual consistency
* Basic principles of visual communication
* Creative conceptualization
* Attention to detail

Design Software

Proficiency in relevant professional design tools is expected, particularly:

* **Adobe Photoshop**
* **Adobe Illustrator**
* **Adobe InDesign** — basic to intermediate knowledge
* **Figma** — basic to intermediate knowledge

Familiarity with additional tools such as **Adobe After Effects, Premiere Pro, Canva, or other relevant creative software** will be an advantage.

Candidates should be comfortable selecting the appropriate software depending on the design requirement.

AI Usage

We prefer candidates with **strong foundational graphic design skills and minimal dependence on AI\-generated design assets**.

AI tools may be used selectively for appropriate supporting tasks such as ideation, research, organization, or workflow assistance, but candidates should be capable of independently:

* Developing visual concepts
* Creating layouts
* Editing and manipulating images
* Working with typography
* Creating vector graphics
* Building social media creatives
* Following brand guidelines
* Making design decisions
* Preparing final artwork

**AI should complement the designer's skills, not replace them.**

Qualifications

* Bachelor's degree/diploma in Graphic Design, Visual Communication, Fine Arts, Multimedia, or a related field is preferred.
* Candidates from other educational backgrounds with a strong design portfolio are also welcome.
* **Freshers are encouraged to apply.**
* Candidates with **up to 2 years of relevant experience** are welcome.
* Internship, freelance, college, or personal design project experience can be considered relevant for freshers.

Portfolio Requirements

A portfolio is **required** and will be an important part of the selection process.

The portfolio should ideally demonstrate:

* Social media creatives
* Branding or visual identity work
* Typography and layout
* Posters or campaign creatives
* Digital advertisements/banners
* Image editing/compositing
* Illustrations or vector artwork
* Creative concepts or campaign work

For freshers, **college projects, personal projects, freelance work, internships, or self\-initiated projects are completely acceptable**.

We are more interested in the candidate's **design thinking, fundamentals, creativity, and execution quality** than the number of years of experience.

Preferred Qualities

* Strong visual sense and creative thinking
* Good attention to detail
* Willingness to learn and experiment
* Ability to take and implement feedback
* Good understanding of current design and social media trends
* Ability to work independently as well as within a team
* Good time\-management and organizational skills
* Ability to handle multiple assignments and deadlines
* Strong sense of ownership
* Good communication skills
* Curiosity and enthusiasm for design

What We Look For

We are looking for someone who:

* Has a genuine interest in graphic design.
* Can explain the thinking behind their designs.
* Understands that good design is more than simply making something look attractive.
* Has strong fundamentals in typography, layout, color, and composition.
* Can create original designs rather than relying heavily on templates.
* Is comfortable experimenting with different visual styles.
* Can turn a written brief into a clear visual concept.
* Understands the importance of consistency in branding.
* Is willing to learn, accept feedback, and improve continuously.

What You Will Work On

Depending on business requirements, your work may include:

* Instagram posts and carousels
* Instagram stories
* LinkedIn creatives
* Social media campaign creatives
* Digital advertisements
* Promotional banners
* Website graphics
* Email creatives
* Event creatives
* Presentation decks
* Posters and flyers
* Brochures and marketing collateral
* Brand assets
* Campaign key visuals
* YouTube/social media thumbnails
* Basic motion graphics or video assets, if required

Performance Expectations

During the first few months, the candidate will be expected to:

* Understand and follow the company's visual identity and brand guidelines.
* Produce clean, accurate, and visually engaging designs.
* Deliver assigned creatives within agreed timelines.
* Demonstrate improvement based on feedback.
* Build familiarity with the company's products, audience, and communication style.
* Develop the ability to independently execute routine design requirements.
* Maintain organized and editable working files.

Why Join Us

* Opportunity to work on real\-world brand and marketing projects.
* Exposure to social media, digital marketing, branding, and campaign design.
* Opportunity to work closely with creative and marketing teams.
* Scope to develop and strengthen professional design skills.
* Opportunity for freshers to build practical industry experience.

Pay: ₹10,000\.00 \- ₹20,000\.00 per month

Benefits:

* Health insurance
* Leave encashment
* Provident Fund

Work Location: In person

title: Director, Product Design
description:
**Company Description**  

It all started when engineer Fred Luddy wrote code that automated a tedious task for his coworker, Phyllis. She cried tears of joy. That moment inspired Fred to build a company that could do that for everyone—freeing people from busywork so they could focus on meaningful work. Today, ServiceNow is the AI control tower for business reinvention. Our ServiceNow AI platform brings together any AI, any data, and any workflow— helping 85% of the Fortune 500® work smarter, faster, and better. We're building an AI\-native culture where technology and talent are unstoppable together. And we're just getting started.


Join us to put AI to work for people.

 **Job Description** **What you get to do in this role:**

* Work collaboratively with our Product teams to deliver great UX that will revolutionize workplace collaboration and productivity for some of the largest companies in the world
* Directly lead and manage 8\-10 designers and/or managers
* Change the way people work through design thinking and develop experiences using AI, Machine Learning and Mobile technology
* Oversee a portfolio of products, while acting as a mentor \& manager to subordinates.
* Work closely with Product and Engineering from strategic definition, planning, architecture, through tactical execution of the Product Roadmaps
* Work with your peers to ensure a unified and cohesive experience across the ServiceNow ecosystem
* Lead user needs assessment, task analysis and develop user profiles; identify key tasks for user research, competitive analysis and user testing, develop usability plans
* Develop high level task flow content and then use storyboards and other design documents to communicate concepts and vision to others
* Rapidly iterate theoretical task scenarios, navigation map, flow, and state\-transition diagrams to document design decisions
* Oversee your team's work: detailed mockups and prototypes and behavior specifications.
* Ensure a consistent experience across the mobile and desktop platforms
* Participate in the development and maintenance of the company Design system to provide examples of core platform components and best practices
* Oversee UI layouts including controls, labels and graphical elements for software on both mobile and desktop platforms with an eye towards experience unification
* Participate in documentation development process such as user experience specifications, testing and evaluation
* Work closely with product management in UX ideation and innovation

  

**Qualifications** **To be successful in this role you have:**

* Experience in leveraging or critically thinking about how to integrate AI into work processes, decision\-making, or problem\-solving. This may include using AI\-powered tools, automating workflows, analyzing AI\-driven insights, or exploring AI's potential impact on the function or industry.
* 15\+ years of enterprise product design experience
* An inspiring portfolio representing the process you follow to build insanely great experiences
* Demonstrated experience in defining and/or working with robust design systems
* Demonstration of any accessible projects you have built
* At least 8 years of visual and interaction design, with 5 years of Experience Design or equivalent.
* At least 3\+ years of experience managing design teams
* Expert with Sketch, Photoshop, or other design tools
* Ability to do rapid prototyping in Axure, Keynote, Framer, Principle or similar tools
* Ability to understand and distill complex problems into clean solutions.
* Must have strong written and verbal English communication skills
* Must have excellent teamwork, communication, and technical problem\-solving skills to contribute within a multi\-functional and multi\-disciplined team
* Obsessed with the relentless pursuit of UX perfection working inside an iterative and agile development environment
* Must be able to work with minimal supervision in a fluid, fast\-paced and truly agile environment
* Expected to demonstrate a high level of initiative, good sense of humor, and a “make it work” ethos
* Must be able to travel up to 20% of the year
* Expertise in one or more of the following product spaces: IT Security Management, IT Operations Management, Security Operations, HR Service Delivery, Customer Service Management (CSM), or Finance \& Legal
* Experience in creating content and/or designing with compliance to WCAG 2\.0/2\.1 AA guidelines is a plus

title: Application Designer
description:
**Project Role :** Application Designer  

**Project Role Description :** Assist in defining requirements and designing applications to meet business process and application requirements.
  

**Must have skills :** DevOps  

**Good to have skills :** Amazon Web Services (AWS), DevOps Architecture  

Minimum **5** year(s) of experience is required  

**Educational Qualification :** 15 years full time education  

  

Job Summary  

  

As a DevOps Engineer, you will design, build, automate, deploy, and support scalable cloud\-native platforms across enterprise environments. A typical day involves collaborating with development, operations, security, and architecture teams to deliver secure, resilient, and highly available solutions. You will leverage Infrastructure as Code (IaC), CI/CD pipelines, containerization, and cloud technologies to enhance platform reliability, deployment efficiency, operational excellence, and automation while driving continuous improvement initiatives.  

  

Roles \& Responsibilities  

Collaborate with cross\-functional teams to deliver project objectives and platform initiatives.  

Design, develop, and maintain Infrastructure as Code (IaC) solutions using Terraform.  

Implement configuration management and automation solutions using Ansible.  

Build, optimize, and support CI/CD pipelines using Jenkins and Git\-based repositories.  

Deploy, manage, and troubleshoot containerized applications using Docker and Kubernetes.  

Configure and support Kubernetes clusters, including Amazon EKS environments.  

Implement deployment strategies such as Rolling, Blue\-Green, and Canary deployments.  

Automate infrastructure provisioning, application deployments, and operational workflows.  

Monitor platform health, identify performance bottlenecks, and conduct root cause analysis.  

Ensure compliance with security, governance, and operational best practices.  

Drive continuous improvement initiatives focused on platform modernization, reliability, and automation.  

Participate in technical discussions and contribute to architecture and design decisions.  

  

Professional \& Technical Skills  

Minimum of 4 to 6 years of experience in DevOps, Cloud Engineering, Platform Engineering, or Site Reliability Engineering (SRE).  

Strong hands\-on experience with Terraform, including module development, remote state management, workspaces, and Infrastructure as Code best practices.  

Experience with Ansible playbooks, roles, dynamic inventory, configuration management, and automation.  

Proficiency in Jenkins CI/CD pipeline development using Declarative Pipelines and Jenkinsfiles.  

Experience with GitHub or GitLab, including branching strategies, pull requests, webhooks, and repository management.  

Strong expertise in Docker containerization, image creation, optimization, and registry management.  

Hands\-on experience with Kubernetes, including cluster administration, troubleshooting, Helm Charts, Kustomize, RBAC, and namespace management.  

Strong knowledge of AWS cloud services, including VPC, Networking, Security Groups, IAM Roles and Policies, EC2, Auto Scaling, EKS/ECS, ECR, S3, CloudWatch, RDS, and DynamoDB.  

Experience implementing enterprise\-scale CI/CD and infrastructure automation solutions.  

Strong Linux administration skills with Bash scripting and working knowledge of Python.  

Proficiency in Git, including rebasing, merge conflict resolution, and repository management.  

Understanding of Agile delivery methodologies and DevOps best practices.  

Experience implementing deployment strategies such as Rolling, Blue\-Green, and Canary deployments.  

Strong troubleshooting, monitoring, and production support experience.  

  

Additional Information  

Experience with GitHub Actions, GitLab CI/CD, or Azure DevOps Pipelines is preferred.  

Exposure to Git Ops tools such as Argo CD and Flux CD is desirable.  

Knowledge of and Open Tofu will be an added advantage.  

Experience with advanced Kubernetes ecosystem tools, including Cluster Auto scaler, Cert\-Manager, AWS Load Balancer Controller, Network Policies, and Ingress Controllers.  

Familiarity with observability and monitoring platforms such as Prometheus, Grafana, ELK Stack, Splunk, Datadog, and Open Telemetry.  

Experience with security and compliance tools, including Trivy, Checkov, tf sec, and image\-signing solutions.  

Exposure to AWS Systems Manager and service mesh technologies such as Istio and Linked.  

Experience working on OTT, Media, Streaming, or high\-traffic digital platforms is preferred.  

Familiarity with AWS Media Services, including Media Live, Media Package, Media Convert, and CloudFront.  

Knowledge of ITSM tools such as ServiceNow and Jira Service Management.  

Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field.  

Preferred certifications include:  

AWS Solutions Architect Associate  

AWS Sys Ops Administrator Associate  

Certified Kubernetes Administrator (CKA)  

Certified Kubernetes Application Developer (CKAD)  

Terraform Associate

description:

**Company:** Sector4 Interactive

**Position:** UI/UX Design Intern

**Location:** \[Insert Remote / On\-site Location]

**Duration:** 3 Months (Unpaid)

**Openings:** 1 Position

**About Sector4 Interactive**

At Sector4 Interactive, we specialize in designing and implementing intuitive, immersive UI/UX for games and interactive applications. We blend aesthetics with functional design to create memorable player and user experiences across interactive media.

**Role Overview**

We are looking for a passionate and detail\-oriented **UI/UX Design Intern** to join our team for a 3\-month program. In this role, you will get hands\-on experience taking UI/UX designs from concept to execution in real\-world game and interactive software environments.

**What You’ll Do**

* **Conceptualize \& Wireframe:** Create user flows, wireframes, and high\-fidelity mockups tailored for interactive media and games.
* **Implement Designs:** Assist in translating visual concepts and UI layouts directly into interactive applications/game engines.
* **Collaborate:** Work closely with developers and artists to ensure seamless integration of user interfaces.
* **Iterate:** Collect feedback, conduct playtesting/usability tests, and refine user interfaces for optimal player experience.

**What We’re Looking For**

* A strong interest in game design, interactive media, and user\-centered design principles.
* Familiarity with design tools (e.g., Figma, Adobe XD, Photoshop, Illustrator).
* basic understanding or eagerness to learn UI implementation within game engines (e.g., Unity, Unreal Engine) or interactive application frameworks.
* Solid communication skills and a strong desire to learn in a collaborative environment.
* A portfolio or selection of work (personal, academic, or professional) showcasing your design process.

**What You’ll Gain**

* Direct, practical experience implementing UI/UX in active interactive projects.
* Portfolio\-ready work showcasing end\-to\-end design and implementation.
* Mentorship from experienced professionals in interactive design.
* A letter of recommendation upon successful completion of the internship.

This is a **3\-month, unpaid learning internship** focused on hands\-on portfolio building and real\-world UI/UX implementation in games. ( *Any monetary listing in the salary field is auto\-generated by the platform standard).*

Ready to shape interactive experiences with us? Send your **Resume** and **Portfolio link** to contact@sector4\.in with the subject line **"UI/UX Internship Application – \[Your Name]"**.

title: Staff UX Designer
description:
**Secure Every Identity, from AI to Human**  

  

Identity is the key to unlocking the potential of AI. Okta secures AI by building the trusted, neutral infrastructure that enables organizations to safely embrace this new era. This work requires a relentless drive to solve complex challenges with real\-world stakes. We are looking for builders and owners who operate with speed and urgency and execute with excellence.  

  

This is an opportunity to do career\-defining work. We're all in on this mission. If you are too, let's talk.

**The Overview**



At Okta, we're building a world where anyone can safely use any technology, and we're specifically focused on protecting the future of work. We bring simple and secure access to people and organizations everywhere, promising to not only protect the identities of our customers' workforce and users but to ask, "what more can we make possible?"



As a Staff Product Designer for Okta, you'll work with a globally distributed design team to apply your craft and expertise on a range of products and services. Our culture provides the opportunity to explore the technologies we're researching and investing in. Some of your work will be functional, practical user experience design, where you will help our design team drive cohesive user experience across Okta's portfolio of products. Other work will be speculative, generative explorations that you carry out in collaboration and partnership across the organization to flesh out, frame, and help prioritize solutions in an ever\-evolving and complex, often ambiguous, problem space.

  


**The Finer Print**



You will lead user experience strategy and execution for our Okta Research \& Development (ORD) business unit. Specifically, ORD will solve every identity use case at work – for all types of people (employees, business partners, contractors, frontline workers), for all types of resources (SaaS, servers, privileged resources, machines, etc.), for the largest and most secure businesses in the world. As a designer, your focus will be on helping us build a secure, trusted, and unified platform with deep integrations.

  


**In this role, you have the opportunity to:**


* Lead a holistic, human\-centered approach to design.
* Guide and oversee the UX strategy alongside cross\-functional partners, collaborating to take products from concept to launch and define the long\-term strategy for your product area.
* Design and facilitate co\-creation design workshops with Product Management, Engineering, and Design to define opportunities within our products to solve valuable customer problems.
* Craft user\-centered artifacts and end\-to\-end journeys to align teams contributing to Workforce Identity Management around the broader user experience.
* Collaborate with other Okta designers to ensure consistency across interface experiences across different user scenarios.
* Inspire teams to think bigger and act smaller, instilling an iterative process and fail\-forward mentality to design simple and delightful user interfaces for new and existing Okta products.
* Advocate, mentor, and educate on the benefits of design thinking to product teams and new designers alike; partnering with UX team members to uphold our principles and standards.
* Mentor junior designers and contribute toward team\-level and design practice and process improvements.
* Work with Design Leadership to define and drive the frameworks, contracts, and standards for others to be able to then build on top of and add value to, ensuring the quality of UX delivery.
* Find creative ways to continuously learn from customers and users; collaborating with user researchers to research and synthesize user needs to help conceive, define, test, and evolve solutions for our users across a range of mediums and experiences; Advocate for users and deliver user and customer outcomes in a dynamic work environment.
* Help product designers create success metrics to illustrate a clear understanding of how their designs impact customers.
* Present work, concepts, and new ideas to cross\-functional team members, adjacent teams, and senior leadership; working to distill complex technical problems into clear, conceptual models and simple, elegant solutions.
* Keep abreast of competitor products and industry trends, including the practical application of AI in the design process; Perform competitive and comparative analysis to understand existing patterns.

  


**Who We Are Looking For**


* You have experience leading cross\-discipline teams and exemplify leadership.
* You are passionate about solving complex problems, crafting and sharing product and design UX principles to help teams deliver cohesive user experiences.
* You are great at collaborating, sharing work early and often, and seeking constructive feedback from peers and stakeholders.
* You are a pragmatist who actively uses AI tools to improve and accelerate your day\-to\-day design workflow.
* Demonstrated, hands\-on experience using AI\-powered design tools (e.g., for ideation, asset generation, or prototyping) in your daily design activities.
* You have the heart of a teacher and can help mentor and train people. You build and share empathy with people to deeply understand them and their needs.
* You are a thought leader, undertaking explorations into new technologies and territories while also delivering practical designs.
* You see design as a partner in shaping strategic and operational product and UX outcomes; comfortable owning all stages of design for multiple teams within a given product area.
* You bring a systems\-thinking lens to the conversation.
* You are passionate about supporting teams with a wide variety of experience, backgrounds, and interests.
* Your portfolio will show that you've worked on complex and/or technical projects across all aspects of the design process (conceptual design, interaction design, information architecture, and visual design).
* You are adept at working in a diverse, globally distributed team and have experience with remote collaboration tools.

  


**Qualifications:**


* 8\+ years of relevant work experience as a Product Designer or UX Designer, with a portfolio showcasing shipped B2B or enterprise products.
* Degree in a related field or relevant work experience as a Product Designer or UX Designer.
* Proficient in Figma, Sketch, Adobe Creative Suite, and/or similar design tools.
* Possesses at least a basic understanding of HTML/CSS/JavaScript.
* Can provide a digital portfolio that showcases solid skills across a variety of projects, including work that has been seen and used successfully in actual products. (Portfolio link required when applying.)
